newsitem.title: USA: Converse says changes registration statement.
newsitem.headline: Converse says changes registration statement.

text.p: Converse Inc said Monday it will offer $60 million in convertible suboridinated notes instead of 4.5 million shares of common stock.
The company said it amended its registration statement previously filed with the Securities and Exchange Commision reflect this change in the public offering.
The company said it will use the proceeds from the sale of convertible subordinated notes to repay debt.
The company said the underwriters of the offering are Smith Barney Inc, Dillon, Read and Co Inc, Dondaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette Securities Corp and Goldman, Sachs and Co.
